usage: 普洱茶 is used as a noun to refer to a type of fermented Chinese tea.
In Cantonese, 普洱 on its own often already means 普洱茶.
普洱 has multiple Cantonese pronunciations in actual usage, and you may hear readings such as pou2 lei2, bou2 lei2, pou2 nei2, or bou2 nei2.
It often appears with tea-related measure words or nouns, such as 杯, 壺, or 茶.
It can be used when ordering tea in places like restaurants or tea houses.
It is also common to use 普洱茶 with words that describe taste, strength, or age.
